NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING OF STOCKHOLDERS OF BARINGTON/HILCO ACQUISITION CORP. To Be Held on February 6, 2017
To the Stockholders of Barington/Hilco Acquisition Corp.: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that a special meeting (the "special meeting") of the stockholders of Barington/Hilco Acquisition Corp., a Delaware corporation ("BHAC" or the "Company"), will be held on February 6, 2017, at 10:00 a.m. Eastern time, to consider a proposal to amend the Company's certificate of incorporation to extend the date by which the Company has to consummate a business combination (the "Extension").
To exercise your redemption rights, you must (i) affirmatively vote either for or against the Charter Amendment and (iii) prior to 5:00 p.m., Eastern time on February 1, 2017 (two business days before the special meeting), (x) submit a written request to our transfer agent that we redeem your public shares for cash.
If the Contribution is made, the pro rata amount per share for redeeming public stockholders at the meeting for such business combination or BHAC's subsequent liquidation will be approximately $10.38 per share, in comparison to the current conversion amount of $10.23 per share (assuming no redemptions). Each warrant entitles the holder to purchase one share at an exercise price of $11.50 per share.
